description: This file is a Java unit test class for DuplicationRetryTimeoutStrategy, which tests its timeout handling logic such as increasing timeouts, maximum timeout constraints, retry counts, and reset functionality.

classes.name: DuplicationRetryTimeoutStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DuplicationRetryTimeoutStrategy, verifying timeout progression, maximum timeout adherence, retry counting, and reset behavior.

methods.name: timeoutIncreasesByDouble
methods.description: Tests that the timeout value doubles each time until reaching the maximum timeout.

methods.name: timeoutUsesMaximum
methods.description: Verifies that the timeout value does not exceed the maximum timeout after multiple calls.

methods.name: triesAreCounted
methods.description: Checks that the number of tries is correctly incremented on each timeout attempt.

methods.name: resetWillResetTimeoutAndTries
methods.description: Ensures that calling reset resets the timeout and tries count to their initial states.
